text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The day before Christmas, Pecorine visits a general store in Landosol looking for a present.
text_block_list.orig_text:
クリスマスを翌日に控えたランドソルの雑貨屋に、
プレゼントを探すペコリーヌが訪れた。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Wow, it's such a cute general store♪ As expected of the most popular store in Landosol right now, there are lots of customers! ☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
わあ、
とってもかわいい雑貨屋さんですね♪
さすが今ランドソルで一番人気のお店、
お客さんもいっぱいです☆

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: If it's here... I might be able to find a fantastic present♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここでなら
素敵なプレゼントが見つかりそうですね♪

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm, but there are only couples and families around... It's a bit lonely being all alone...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……う～ん、
でも
周りはカップルや親子連ればかりですね……
一人はちょっぴり寂しいです……

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Maybe I should have invited {0}-kun... Ah, I can't...
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くんを誘えばよかったかな……
あ、
だめです……

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: If I did that, the surprise would be ruined...
text_block_list.orig_text: それではサプライズになりませんから……

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: HYAAAAH?! Geez, {0}-kun?! You're the one who gave me a surprise here...!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひゃっ！？　{0}くんっ！？
もう、
今のがサプライズですよ……！！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Wait a sec, that outfit... Could you be working part-time here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ていうか、
その格好……
もしかして
このお店でアルバイトを？

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Suddenly he went in clerk mode!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 急に店員モード！！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: U-Umm... I'm here to buy Christmas presents. One's for Creditta and the other... umm... for someone else.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あの……
クリスマスのプレゼントを買いに来たんです。
クレジッタさんと……
その……
もう一人の方に。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: I wanted to give a surprise gift to thank the two people who helped me out this Christmas.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今回のクリスマスで
お世話になったお二人に、
感謝のサプライズプレゼントを用意したくて。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: I-I can't really say that! Especially not to you... Ahaha.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
それは言えませんよ……！
……
特に
あなたには～
……あはは。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: F-For now, let us put the gift for that other someone aside... Is there a present you think Creditta would like to have?
text_block_list.orig_text:
と、
とりあえず
もう一人の方は一旦置いといて……
クレジッタさんに喜んで貰えそうなプレゼントってありますか？

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... I'd be happy if that were the case, but since I'm here, I wanted to give her a special present regardless...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは……
そうならうれしいんですけど、
せっかくなら、
ならではって感じのプレゼントをしたくて……

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: I think she may have a lot of expensive clothes and accessories, so I figured I'd go for something a little bit unusual and original.
text_block_list.orig_text:
高価な服やアクセサリーは
たくさん持ってると思うので、
ちょっと変わった雑貨でもないかな～
と。

text_block_list.text: Peco-san, if it's from you anything would make her happy.
text_block_list.orig_text: ペコさんからなら何でもうれしいと思う！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Huh? Yes, you just said that... Wait, what...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
ええ、
それはさっき……
って、
あれ……？

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Could that voice I just heard... come from here? ..."Recorded Voice Alarm Clock".
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしかして今の声、
これですか？
……
『録音ボイス目覚まし時計』

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: I heard about this item here! It's really popular right now and it's almost all sold out, right? Is that the last one in this store...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
知ってますよこれ。
今すごいブームで
ほとんど売り切れちゃってるんですよね？
この店も
それが最後の一つですか……

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: ...I know! This will make a wonderful present for Creditta-san!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そうだ。
クレジッタさんへのプレゼントに、
これ、
いいですね！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: If I record on it my usual messages of gratitude and support, and then give it to her, she will surely be happy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いつもの感謝や
応援の声を吹き込んで渡せば、
きっと喜んでくれるのでは！？

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Wait... Could I be getting too conceited here...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
って……
うぬぼれちゃってますかね～……？

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Just as reference... How about you, {0}-kun?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちなみにですけど……
{0}くんはどうです？

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Would you be happy to have... my voiced alarm clock?
text_block_list.orig_text:
わたしの声入り目覚まし時計なんて……
うれしいですか？

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: ...!!! I-I see... Ehehe.
text_block_list.orig_text:
！！！
そ、
そうですか……
えへへ。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: ...Understood! I'll take this as a present then! Then please, I'd like this last one wrapped up...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
分かりました！
プレゼントは
これにします！
じゃあ
この最後の一つ
くださ……

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Wait, it's GONE!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
ありませんっ！！！

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: *pant pant*... I finally found it...! I finally got my hands on a "Recorded Voice Alarm Clock"!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はあ、
はあ……
やっと見つけた……！
ついにゲットできたぜ
『録音ボイス目覚まし時計』！！

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: I'm sure my daughter will be overjoyed with this Christmas present! Boss, please send me the bill! Oh, sorry for that, young lady!
text_block_list.orig_text:
このクリスマスプレゼントで
娘も大喜び間違いなしだ！
おやっさん、
お勘定頼むよ！　
っと、
お嬢ちゃん
前ごめんよっ！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: ...I-I guess it sold out... You really don't have more in stock, do you...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……う、
売れちゃいました……
在庫は
もうないんですよね……？

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: R-Really?! So you believe the store owner might know more details...?! MR. OWNERRRR...!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほ、
本当ですか！？
詳しくは
店主さんがご存じなんですね……！
店主さ～ん！！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: All right... We're here! {0}-kun!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし……
到着しましたねっ！
{0}くん！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: It grows on the top of this snowy mountain... It's a mysterious plant that can memorize sound and play it back over and over...
text_block_list.orig_text:
この雪山の頂上に生えているんですね……
音声を記憶し、
繰り返し再生するという不思議な草……

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Its name is... "Repeating Grass"!! How crazy is that☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
その名も
『繰りかえ草』……！！
やばいですね☆

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: That'd be the mainstream alternative of it, but there's been a retro boom lately, you know? You can't keep recording forever with the grass, and the ephemerality of the sound, which fades away and can no longer be heard, is what makes it so popular!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっちが主流なんですけど、
レトロブームみたいですよ？
いつまでも録音しておけるわけではなく、
枯れると聞こえなくなる儚さが人気なんですって！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: See, even if I inject my voice into the alarm clock, you won't be able to see me, so you'd have to come and visit me to fulfill that wish... That's why it's so popular. How romantic☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
目覚ましに声を吹き込んでも、
声が聞こえなくなっちゃうから、
定期的に会いに行かなきゃいけない……
と、
人気だそうです。
ロマンチックですね☆

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Building one isn't too complex, so the owner promised to make one for us if we get our hands on some "Repeating Grass" for him!
text_block_list.orig_text:
構造は簡単ですから
『繰りかえ草』が手に入れば、
店主さんが作ってくれる約束って言ってましたし！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: With that said, let us head to the summit before it gets dark!
text_block_list.orig_text:
では
暗くなる前に
頂上を目指しましょう！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: ...Even so, we must make sure to be careful...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……といっても、
一筋縄ではいかなそうですね……！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Yes, you too, {0}-kun! ...Furthermore this... is a monster I've never seen before...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
{0}くんも！
……
しかし
これは、
見たこともない魔物です……！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Could it be that the ecosystem itself has changed in this snowy mountain due to the winter season? This monster...
text_block_list.orig_text:
冬の雪山で
いつもと生態系が変わってるんでしょうか？
この魔物……

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: ...It looks so DELICIOUS☆
text_block_list.orig_text: ……おいしそうです☆

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... {0}-kun it seems like we can add another dish to tomorrow's Christmas party♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへっ……
{0}くん、
明日のクリスマスパーティーに
もう一品増やせそうですね♪

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: ...And just as I said that, here comes more and more!
text_block_list.orig_text: ……言ってるそばから次々と！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Prepare yourself, please! You've been recruited as our second and third dishes, you know!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ご覚悟ください！
２品目、
３品目として
おいしくいただきますからね！！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Phew~☆ Lots of delicious ingredients have just piled up for us to get! I'm already drooling~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふう～☆　
おいしそうな食材がたくさんゲットできましたね！
よだれが出ちゃいます～♪

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: No... Even I wouldn't be that wild☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
いえ、
さすがにそこまでワイルドじゃないですよ☆

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Ah, I know! Halfway up the mountain, there's a cabin that the Royal Knights of NIGHTMARE use as a local station! It should be just up ahead, so we can cook those ingredients there☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだ！　
山の中腹に、
【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】が
駐留するための
山小屋があるんです！
この先にあるはずですから
そこで調理を☆

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~, boil, bake, steam, smoke... I wonder just how I should cook all this~☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ～っ、
煮る、
焼く、
蒸す、
燻す……
どう調理しちゃいましょうか～☆

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: O-Of course I know that! Our goal is to obtain that grass, after all! Ahahaha~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
も……
もちろんですよ！
あくまで目的は
『繰りかえ草』ですもんね～……！
あははは～……♪

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: W-Well then, let's pull ourselves together and head to the top☆ Let's go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
それじゃあ
気を取り直して、
頂上目指して
レッツゴーです☆

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Uh... Ugh... Somehow we managed to make it to the top of the mountain, but... There's a harsh blizzard...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
う……
ううっ……
どうにか山頂には着きましたけど……
すごい吹雪です……！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... This is the outfit that Creditta herself prepared for me. This cape is surprisingly warm... ee... ee...
text_block_list.orig_text:
は、
はい……
さすが
クレジッタさんが用意してくれた衣装です。
このマント、
驚くほど暖かくて……
は……
は……

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: *sneeze*!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
は
っくしょん！！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Ah... Ahaha, that said I suppose there's still a limit to what it can do. We need to find that "Repeating Grass" fast...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ……
あはは、
とはいっても
限度はありますね～
早く
『繰りかえ草』を見つけなきゃ……

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Ah, you're right! There's no doubt about it...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ほんとだ！
あれに間違いありませんね……！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: ...Okay, I got it...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
よしっ
採れました……！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness... With this, now I can have Creditta-san's gift prepared.
text_block_list.orig_text:
良かった……
これでクレジッタさんにプレゼントを用意できます！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Just as reference... How about you, {0}-kun?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちなみにですけど……
{0}くんはどうです？

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Would you be happy to have... my voiced alarm clock?
text_block_list.orig_text:
わたしの
声入り目覚まし時計なんて……
うれしいですか？

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: You'd be more than happy... I-I see... Ehehe.
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごくうれしい……
そ、
そうですか……
えへへ。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: ...That's right!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
そうですっ！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: I need just one more "Repeating Grass"...! Please wait a moment!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あと一つ
『繰りかえ草』を……！
ちょっと
待っててくださいね！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Don't worry! I can see another one right over there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫！
すぐそこに、
もう一本見えてますから！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Just a bit more... Just a little more and...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう少し……
もう少しで
手が……！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: ...Okay! Grass, get! Now I can make one more-... KYAAAAAAHHH!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……よしっ！　
ゲットです！
これでもう一つ……
きゃああっ！！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: A-Ahaha. So this right here was a cliff... I almost fell because of my poor visibility.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あはは。
ここ、
崖になってました……
視界が悪くって
危うく落ちちゃうとこでしたね。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Thanks to you holding my hand right on time, I'm saved☆
text_block_list.orig_text: あなたが手を取ってくれたおかげで助かりました☆

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: NGHHHH!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ううぅっ！！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Th-This is bad...! {0}, please let go of my hand!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
まずいです……！
あなた、
手を放してください！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: At this rate, you'll fall down with me...
text_block_list.orig_text: このままじゃあなたも一緒に……

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: KYAAAAAAAHHHHH!!
text_block_list.orig_text: きゃああああ～～～！！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Pecorine and {0} are blown off the snowy mountain by a strong wind and fall...
text_block_list.orig_text:
強風にあおられ雪山から転げ落ちてしまった
ペコリーヌと{0}……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Whatever will happen to the two of them, is to be known...
text_block_list.orig_text: 果たして二人は、どうなってしまうのか……
